review.notes: Word-level diff of the PDF text layer against the OCR markdown for all 25 physical pages plus a whole-document digit-token inventory (residual PDF-only tokens are the arXiv stamp, page numerals, and figure-internal chart values such as the noise-std axis labels). All 8 figures are embedded as raster images, so the demo-task labels around Figure 1, the Figure 2 training-sequence tokens (bos/dog on rock/eoi), the Figure 3 character-pipeline flowchart text, and the Figure 7/8 panel labels are figure-internal and not transcription defects. Equation (2) is faithfully transcribed in LaTeX. Remaining word diffs are line-break hyphen artifacts (long-context, knowledge-aware, flow-matching, lower-dimensional, SeedEdit, vision-language, Chain-of-Thought, high-fidelity, deepmind, flux, introducing, native).
